vetSays.line: A woman, maybe 20s, with a scarred cheek is at the cookpot, tasting off the spoon, frowning, adding a pinch of something. Better close to the fire today.
📋 A woman, maybe 20s, with a scarred cheek — 🪾 Gather deadfall. They'll report back by next part.
🍂 A woman, maybe 20s, with a scarred cheek gathers deadfall — 1 stick + 1 fiber. The pile grows. (1 sticks now.)
A woman, maybe 20s, with a scarred cheek heads out to forage. "Out for a forage. If I'm late, start without me." The pantry won't fill itself.
A woman, maybe 20s, with a scarred cheek hesitates, then backs off. "Not today. Sorry." (Low trust — reluctant.)
🛡️ Thao, Diego, Arjun and the woman in her 30s met them at the door — 1 put down, 3 driven off. Thao, the woman in her 30s are hurt.
★ IDENTIFIED: European Elder. Elder. Big shrub; flat white flower plates in June, drooping black berry clusters in late summer. Uses unknown — harvest, taste, and learn.
📚 Village knowledge: Catalina taught everyone about European Elder. The Codex grows without you lifting a finger.
Desmond has been asking about the strange leaves all week — "but what IS it?" Tonight, an answer. Catalina drew European Elder in the dirt for the others. It'll wash away. The knowledge won't.
The fire burns low. One new line in the journal: European Elder — named and noted.
🛡️ Thao, Diego, Arjun, Siobhan and Brian met them at the door — 4 put down, 1 driven off. Thao, Diego, Arjun, Brian are hurt.
🌿 European Elder — the foragers have handled it 8 days running. They know it now — which parts are worth hauling, which bruise, how it wants to be carried. The village's knowledge deepens.
💡 European Elder: the village knows more than you do. Harvest it a few more times (0/3) and it'll click.

📺 "Oh, you survived the AUDIENCE NOTES? Cute. We've stopped pretending these are animals now. That was the FINAL DRAFT, folks — what comes out of the treeline next was never alive the way you mean it."
📺 SYSTEM: "Oh — OH. Everybody saw that, right? Diego just put down The Callback... on CAMERA. That's a veteran kill, folks. REMEMBER the name."
🛡️ Diego, Arjun, Siobhan, Miras and Brian met them at the door — 4 put down, 1 barely walked away. Diego, Arjun, Brian are hurt.
📺 SYSTEM: "Oh — OH. Everybody saw that, right? Emma just put down Gavel... on CAMERA. That's a veteran kill, folks. REMEMBER the name."
📺 SYSTEM: "Oh — OH. Everybody saw that, right? Emma just put down The Big Beast... on CAMERA. That's a veteran kill, folks. REMEMBER the name."
🛡️ Arjun, Siobhan, Miras, Brian and Emma met them at the door — 2 put down, 3 barely walked away. Arjun, Siobhan, Miras, Brian, Emma are hurt.
📺 SYSTEM: "Oh — OH. Everybody saw that, right? Miras just put down Spool... on CAMERA. That's a veteran kill, folks. REMEMBER the name."
📺 "We've been watching you for a LONG time. Your faiths. Your formats. Your little institutions. So we built something out of... well. Out of YOU. Say hello to the MIRROR DRAFT."
📺 SYSTEM: "Oh — OH. Everybody saw that, right? Miras just put down Ad Break... on CAMERA. That's a veteran kill, folks. REMEMBER the name."
🌿 European Elder, weeks in the baskets. Handling it day after day, the village has learned what it's FOR — not just what it is. The village knows its uses now.
💡 European Elder: the village knows more than you do. Harvest it a few more times (0/2) and it'll click.
📺 SYSTEM: "Oh — OH. Everybody saw that, right? Aria just put down The Big Beast... on CAMERA. That's a veteran kill, folks. REMEMBER the name."

◈ ARC IV — THE INEFFICIENCY. SYSTEM: "ROUNDING ERROR RECLASSIFIED: ANOMALY. Organic consumption yields impossible output. Recalculating. Recalculating." — They finally see it. The thing they laughed at — needing to EAT — is the engine. Their confusion is your weapon now. You stood up to the calibration fauna, the audience's notes, the Final Draft — lived through their Show, weathered the worst together, and built something bigger than a village. One day humanity will need a case to make. The case is made of deeds, not words — and yours, though unfinished, are undeniable. (Feasted buffs burn ho
📺 "But finales — FINALES need a LEGEND, sweetheart. More STANDING — blood, bonds, or bread — and look the Mirror Draft in the eye. The producers are WAITING."

◈ SYSTEM: "Four waves. FOUR. The producers are — okay, I'm saying it: FINALES need a NATION. You've got a region; now make it a REALM. Bind fires under one head, or bend the knee to someone who has. The higher-ups are watching. ...Did I say higher-ups? I said NOTHING. Forget the higher-ups."

regDeaths.name: the creek went still, and your arm-hairs stood up
